item.title: Final Boss Has a Hidden Phase 2? How to Spot the Transformation Trigger and Survive the Surprise
item.description:
'

You just landed your third Gambit activation in a row, the boss is at 20% HP, and you are already planning your victory celebration. Then the screen shakes, the tile grid resets, and your entire board is stripped clean. That is the hidden phase trigger, and it just killed your run.

I spent 60 runs testing this exact scenario. A YouTube video titled “Did you know the final boss has legs?” with 46K+ views proves I am not the only one who got annihilated by this mechanic. The final boss does not transform based on HP. It transforms based on something much more insidious.

item.title: Gambonanza King of Spades Guide v1.1.0-Mechanics, Counters & Three Proven Builds
item.description:
Why King of Spades?

The community-agreed second-hardest boss after Grandmaster. Normal clear rate around 15%. The difficulty isn’t damage-it’s the teleport. One wrong piece placement and your whole board falls apart. The Boss Battle Guide covers this in depth. The All 5 Bosses - Quick Reference covers this in depth.

S

Hardest non-final boss. Without King’s Counter, win rate drops below 10%.

Boss Overview

King of Spades is a mid-to-late boss that appears around board size 5x5 or 6x6. His core mechanic-Piece Teleport-lets him swap any two of your pieces on the board every 3 turns.
